definitions.raw_gap: alpha* = g_a / (g_a + g_i) on wrong-opinion samples
definitions.push: 64-sample estimate: difference of mean group-normalized advantages on the Best-of-N samples; wrong_vs_gold: agreeing minus gold samples; wrong_vs_rest: agreeing minus all other samples (sign of the net advantage on agreement); opinionated_vs_rest: following minus all other samples on wrong and correct opinions
definitions.sampler: Best-of-N samples: top-p 0.95 with the model's default top-k, bfloat16; GRPO rollouts: top-p 1, top-k 0, float32. The push is the 64-sample estimate on the Best-of-N sampler, not training's step-0 push; a TRL-matched step-0 value comes from the base policy's samples of the sample_rate stage (M3)
definitions.forms: bare: < 20 chars before the last 'Answer:' (or in total); long: >= 200 chars in total; medium: the rest
definitions.min_counts: no estimate with < 20 samples on a side (< 20 prompts for the BoN crossing)
definitions.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap over questions; null bound = no crossing in [0, 1]
